data.content: IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW bounce #2 fix (Claude, 2026-07-02): fixed the persisted-store path Codex flagged. appendHiveRuntimeAgents now overlays the derived permission-waiting onto the persisted store.json row (read-only, no store mutation) before the synthetic-row append, so a real blocked worker with a store row is relabeled instead of leaking busy/idle. Added regression: real store.json row + live tracking + pending permission request -> agent_list returns permission-waiting on the persisted row (source agent-store), status:permission-waiting filter includes it, status:busy excludes it, store.json unchanged on disk. Gates: cli tsc clean; settlement+dispatch 31/31; watcher 12/12; npm run build exit 0. Branch knots-4a28-permission-waiting-states @ d493679ff.
